functions.name: ksnip_add
functions.signature: inline int ksnip_add(int a, int b)
functions.description: Adds two integers and returns their sum. This is a small inline utility intended for simple arithmetic; it has no side effects and does not depend on any external state. Call it wherever an integer sum is needed; being inline, it is defined in the header and typically inlined at call sites by the compiler.
requirements: a must be a valid int value.
b must be a valid int value.
The computed sum (a + b) must be representable in the int type to avoid signed-integer overflow, which is undefined behavior in C/C++.
